title: Puzzle theme
description: A warm, friendly fintech light theme: off-white powder page with white cards, near-black ink, a deep brand violet for whole bands, soft and pale violets for buttons and callouts, and a spring-green accent. Figtree for headings and body at regular weights, JetBrains Mono for uppercase eyebrows. A violet-black night sibling.
notes: primary is the deep violet used for bands and hover fills; the main solid button is the ink (foreground) colour
glow is the spring green: blocks use it at 20–30% for the mint surfaces
